_comment: How each access method may be used, one entry per `ats` value in ats-registry.json. Hand-maintained and dated: `checked` is the day the terms and robots.txt were last read. `permitted` is true only where the provider documents public, unauthenticated reading of published postings, or the employer's own site serves them with robots.txt allowing the path read; false means the collection method is suspended and every registry row on it must be parked; 'unclear' means read today but owed a decision, which the health report names every day. `breaking` lists dated changes the provider has announced; the report warns 75 days ahead. Read by lib/source-registry.mjs. Background: L3vlup docs/tracker-coverage-consulting-vc-2026-11.md, section 2.

greenhouse.basis: Job Board API documented as public; only application submission needs a key. robots.txt disallows /embed/ only.
greenhouse.attribution: Link each role to the employer's own posting.
greenhouse.limitations: Rate limited without a stated figure.

lever.basis: Postings API: published postings are public and 'may be scraped by third parties'. robots.txt asks Crawl-delay: 1.
lever.attribution: Link each role to the employer's own posting.
lever.limitations: Keep at least one second between requests.

ashby.basis: Public job posting API, no authentication documented.
ashby.attribution: Link each role to the employer's own posting.
ashby.limitations: A token can belong to an unrelated company with a similar name; confirm the board names the firm.

workable.basis: Workable documents www.workable.com/api/accounts/{x} as its public endpoint; the widget path used is undocumented. apply.workable.com robots.txt allows all, with ai-train=no.
workable.attribution: Link each role to the employer's own posting.

workday.basis: No published API. Tenant robots.txt disallows the human career paths, not /wday/cxs/. Workday's site terms prohibit scraping 'our Sites' and do not say whether customer tenants are included.
workday.attribution: Link each role to the employer's own posting.
workday.limitations: Keyword walk capped at 600 postings a firm; the list hides location on some tenants until the detail page is read.

talnet.basis: The employer's public job board, server-rendered; no robots exclusion on the board paths read.
talnet.attribution: Link each role to the employer's own posting.
talnet.limitations: About half of tenants serve a bot check; those are parked, never worked around.

oracle.basis: The public REST collection behind Oracle Recruiting Cloud's candidate site; no published terms for third-party reading found.
oracle.attribution: Link each role to the employer's own posting.
oracle.limitations: Requires the expand parameter or returns no requisitions.

eightfold.basis: The endpoint behind the employer's own campus site; no published terms for third-party reading found.
eightfold.attribution: Link each role to the employer's own posting.
eightfold.limitations: Paginates with a hard page cap.

janestreet.attribution: Link each role to the employer's own posting.

rolandberger.basis: The employer's own careers page; robots.txt allows all.
rolandberger.attribution: Link each role to the SmartRecruiters posting the employer's page links to.
rolandberger.limitations: Roles posted only through recruitment partners do not appear.

smartrecruiters.basis: api.smartrecruiters.com/robots.txt disallows every crawler except LinkedInBot (read 27 November 2026). Suspended: every row on this method is parked or moved to the employer's own page.
smartrecruiters.limitations: PA Consulting (188 postings) is reachable only here and is not added.

recruitee.attribution: Link each role to the employer's own posting.
recruitee.limitations: From the date below every call needs the employer's careers-site token in X-Careers-Sites-Token. The collector sends it when RECRUITEE_TOKEN_<TOKEN> is set in the environment, and reports the board as needing a token when it answers 401.

breaking.what: Calls without X-Careers-Sites-Token return 401. PAI Partners stops answering unless the employer issues a token or another permitted source is found.

pinpoint.basis: The JSON behind the employer's careers site; no official documentation for it found.
pinpoint.attribution: Link each role to the employer's own posting.

avature.basis: The employer's public careers site; terms not reviewed for third-party reading.
avature.attribution: Link each role to the employer's own posting.

taleo.attribution: Link each role to the employer's own posting.

custom.attribution: Link each role to the employer's own posting.

notRead.getro: Venture portfolio boards (jobs.accel.com, vistaequitypartners.getro.com). Getro's terms cover 'any job board operated by Getro' and prohibit crawling or scraping. Not read without written permission from the fund or Getro.
notRead.consider: Venture talent boards (jobs.sequoiacap.com, jobs.lsvp.com, careers.balderton.com). Consider's terms section 1.4(l) prohibit automated access without written permission, although robots.txt allows all. Not read without written permission.
